design_overview: UniStudy is designed as a modern, student-focused mobile application with clean card-based layouts, intuitive navigation, and clear visual hierarchy. The design prioritizes discoverability of notes, easy group collaboration, and seamless content sharing. The interface uses a fresh academic color palette with purple as primary to convey trust and creativity, complemented by warm accents for engagement. All screens are designed for touch interaction with generous tap targets, readable typography, and logical user flows that mirror real student workflows.

responsive_design: The application uses a mobile-first approach with flexible layouts that adapt to different screen sizes. Components use relative sizing (percentages and viewport units) with maximum widths to prevent over-stretching on tablets. Bottom navigation collapses to a hamburger menu on very small screens. Cards stack vertically on mobile and may display in 2-column grid on tablets. Typography scales proportionally. Touch targets maintain minimum 48px height across all devices. Horizontal scrolling is used for chip groups and quick actions to preserve vertical space.
accessibility: All interactive elements have minimum 48px touch targets. Color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components). Icons are paired with text labels. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholders. Focus states are clearly indicated with primary color outlines. Screen reader support includes semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Error messages are descriptive and associated with form fields. Keyboard navigation is supported for web version. Animations can be disabled via system preferences.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: button press shows ripple effect with 200ms duration, card taps scale down to 0.98 for 150ms, page transitions slide horizontally with 300ms ease-out, bottom sheets slide up with 250ms ease-in-out, loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect, pull-to-refresh shows circular progress indicator, toast notifications fade in/out over 200ms, tab switches include sliding underline animation, modals fade background overlay to 40% opacity over 200ms. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Icons use a consistent outline style from a single icon family (Feather or Lucide). Standard icons include: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (bookmark outline), heart (heart outline), filter (funnel), plus (plus sign), edit (pencil), trash (trash bin), share (share arrow). Icons are 24px by default, 20px in compact contexts, always paired with labels in navigation. Icon color matches text color in inactive state, primary color when active.
